laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: Los Glaciares (including Portada El Chaltén) ARS 50,000; Perito Moreno and Monte León ARS 25,000. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. No RBA rate for ARS.
laws.heading: Pase diario

laws.rule: Los Glaciares north zone (Los Cóndores, Cerro Torre Base Fitz Roy, Río Eléctrico): tickets online only, paid by credit or debit card; no cash.
